name: localmind-core-v1
description: 40 prompts across 8 categories for cross-model comparison on constrained hardware.

prompts.prompt: In two sentences, what is the difference between RAM and storage in a computer?
What does the acronym API stand for, and what does an API do? Answer in under 50 words.
Name the seven layers of the OSI model in order, from layer 1 to layer 7.
What is the capital city of Australia, and why is it not Sydney?
Explain what HTTP status code 404 means and give one common cause.
What is the boiling point of water at sea level in both Celsius and Fahrenheit?
A train leaves at 14:20 and the journey takes 3 hours 55 minutes. What time does it arrive? Show your working.
If all Bloops are Razzies, and all Razzies are Lazzies, are all Bloops definitely Lazzies? Explain your reasoning in one short paragraph.
A shop sells pens at 12 rupees each. I have 100 rupees. How many pens can I buy and how much change do I get?
Sara is taller than Mia. Mia is taller than Ana. Ana is taller than Ravi. Who is the shortest, and who is the second tallest?
You have a 3-litre jug and a 5-litre jug and unlimited water. Describe how to measure exactly 4 litres.
My server responds in 200 ms when idle and 2000 ms under load. Load happens 10% of the time. What is the average response time?
Compute 17 * 24 and show the intermediate steps.
What is 15% of 240? Give just the number and a one-line calculation.
Solve for x: 3x + 7 = 25. Show each step.
A model generates 40 tokens per second. How long, in seconds, does a 600-token reply take? Give one decimal place.
Write a Python function `is_palindrome(s)` that ignores case, spaces and punctuation. Return only the code.
Write a Python one-liner that reverses the keys and values of a dictionary `d`.
Write a bash command that finds all .log files under /var/log modified in the last 24 hours.
Write a Python function using `requests` that GETs a URL and retries 3 times with exponential backoff. Return only the code.
In SQL, what is the difference between INNER JOIN and LEFT JOIN? Answer in under 60 words.

Extract the entities from this sentence as JSON with keys people, organizations, locations, dates:
"On 12 March 2024, Priya Raman of Infosys met Daniel Cho in Bengaluru."
Return JSON with keys intent, device, value, unit for this command: "set the living room thermostat to 22 degrees"
Return JSON with keys label, confidence, rationale classifying the sentiment of: "The battery life is fine but the screen flickers constantly."
From this line, return JSON with keys people, organizations, amounts: "Arun Kumar invoiced TCS for 45000 rupees."
Return JSON with keys intent, device, confidence for: "is the garage door still open?"
Return JSON with keys label, confidence, rationale for the sentiment of: "Honestly the best purchase I have made all year."

Summarise in exactly 3 bullet points:
"Edge deployment means running models on the device that produced the data. It removes network round trips, keeps private data local, and works without connectivity. The trade-off is limited memory and compute, which forces smaller or quantized models."

Summarise this in one sentence under 25 words:
"Quantization reduces the numeric precision of model weights from 16-bit floats to 8-bit or 4-bit integers, cutting memory use and often increasing speed, at some cost to accuracy."

Give a title and a 2-sentence summary of:
"Time to first token measures the delay before a user sees any output. Tokens per second measures how fast the rest streams. A model can win on one and lose badly on the other, so both must be reported."
In under 40 words, summarise the main risk of relying on a cloud LLM API for a hospital record system.
List exactly 4 benefits of running an LLM locally. Use a numbered list. No introduction, no conclusion.
Answer with a single word only: what is the largest planet in our solar system?
Reply with exactly the text HELLO_WORLD and nothing else.
Explain TCP in under 30 words, without using the words 'protocol' or 'packet'.
Write three short lines about rain. Each line must start with the word 'Rain'.
Write a 4-line poem about a laptop running an AI model offline.
Write a friendly 3-sentence product description for an offline voice assistant for rural clinics.
Draft a 2-sentence apology email opening for a delayed software delivery.
